meta.name: Bay of Bengal Monsoon Depression (Extreme Day 5+ Bust)
meta.description: Simulates a deepening low-pressure depression over the Bay of Bengal. By Day 5-8, numerical NWP models fail to resolve localized trough surge, causing a severe precipitation bust in Odisha, Bengal, and Central India.

meta.name: Western Disturbance Trough Divergence (Day 6-9 Bust)
meta.description: An intense upper-tropospheric trough enters the Western Himalayas. Model ensemble bifurcates over Day 6-8, yielding temperature anomalies >5°C and unpredicted cloudburst risk.

meta.name: Pre-Monsoon Convective Squall & Heatwave Break (Day 4-7 Bust)
meta.description: High surface heating triggers intense convective instability (CAPE > 3200 J/kg) over Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Gangetic plains with sudden squall lines missed by medium-range deterministic runs.

meta.name: Stable Quiescent High-Pressure Flow (Nominal Forecast)
meta.description: Post-monsoon continental high pressure dominating the subcontinent. Predictability remains exceptionally high across all 10 days with minimal bust risk.
